# JUDO JSL Springboot Archetype

> A Maven Archetype that scaffolds Spring Boot applications with JUDO JSL (JUDO Specific Language) support, generating ready-to-build projects with model-driven code generation for DAOs, APIs, Spring configuration, and Liquibase database migrations.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4+ with archetype-packaging extension
- Single-module project — the archetype template lives under `src/main/resources/archetype-resources/`
- Template engine: Apache Velocity with `__paramName__` filename substitution and `${symbol_pound}`/`${symbol_dollar}` escaping
- Generated projects use Spring Boot 3.5.0 with `judo-spring-maven-plugin` for model-to-code generation
- Part of the [judo-community](https://github.com/BlackBeltTechnology/judo-community) ecosystem
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, usage instructions, archetype parameters, and generated project structure
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with build commands, directory structure, coding conventions, and important notes
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup and contribution guidelines
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): CI/CD workflow documentation with Mermaid diagrams

## Core Files

- [pom.xml](pom.xml): Main POM — archetype packaging, dependency version properties, build profiles (updateVersions, archetypeTest, release)
- [src/main/resources/META-INF/maven/archetype-metadata.xml](src/main/resources/META-INF/maven/archetype-metadata.xml): Archetype descriptor — defines parameters (modelName, groupId, etc.), validation regexes, default values, and file sets
- [src/main/resources/archetype-resources/pom.xml](src/main/resources/archetype-resources/pom.xml): Velocity template POM for generated projects — Spring Boot parent, JUDO plugin configuration

## Archetype Template Files

- [src/main/resources/archetype-resources/src/main/java/__applicationName__.java](src/main/resources/archetype-resources/src/main/java/__applicationName__.java): Template for the Spring Boot main class
- [src/main/resources/archetype-resources/src/main/resources/model/__modelName__.jsl](src/main/resources/archetype-resources/src/main/resources/model/__modelName__.jsl): Sample JSL model with Person entity demonstrating the DSL syntax
- [src/main/resources/archetype-resources/src/main/resources/application.yml](src/main/resources/archetype-resources/src/main/resources/application.yml): Template Spring config — HSQLDB datasource, Liquibase changelog, JUDO model name
- [src/main/resources/archetype-resources/README.md](src/main/resources/archetype-resources/README.md): Template README for generated projects

## Integration Tests

- [src/test/resources/projects/basic/archetype.properties](src/test/resources/projects/basic/archetype.properties): Test parameters (modelName=Shop) for archetype generation and build verification
- [src/test/resources/projects/basic/goal.txt](src/test/resources/projects/basic/goal.txt): Maven goal to run on the generated test project

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): CI build workflow
- [.github/workflows/release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml): Release workflow
- [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt): EPL-2.0 license text
- [logback-test.xml](logback-test.xml): Test logging configuration
- [.mvn/jvm.config](.mvn/jvm.config): JVM flags — 2GB heap, UTF-8, --add-opens for Java 21
